setupHelpUrls.label: Create optional classic GHCR package token

deployment.tokenType: classic GitHub personal access token with repo, workflow, and read:packages for the one-token setup; or a fine-grained repository token plus a separate classic package-read PAT for least privilege
requiredPermissions: Select the repository owner and only the repositories Hypervibe should manage. Grant Metadata read; Administration read/write; Actions read/write; Contents read/write; Issues read/write; Pull requests read/write; Secrets read/write; and Workflows read/write.

When enabled in desired state, also grant Dependabot alerts read/write, Code scanning alerts read/write, and Secret scanning alerts read/write. Organization policy and product entitlement can still block these settings; Hypervibe reports that without claiming success.

For the one-token classic PAT setup, grant repo, workflow, and read:packages. Map the same source to both apiToken and packageReadToken in credentialsMap. A single credentialsRef assigns only the API role.

For private GHCR image pulls, packageReadToken must have read:packages — create it here: https://github.com/settings/tokens/new?scopes=read%3Apackages&description=Hypervibe+GHCR+pull+for+companion-refresh. This can be the same classic PAT only when that PAT also has repo + workflow + read:packages.
notes: The fine-grained creation link pre-fills the token name, description, 90-day expiry, core repository permissions, and the resource owner when its exact scope is known. Review the owner and select the repositories manually; GitHub does not document a repository-selection URL parameter. For a classic PAT, select expiration manually; its description does not restrict repository access.

Save the repository-management PAT as HYPERVIBE_GITHUB_TOKEN in an existing gitignored .env file, replace /absolute/path in the Connect command with that file's directory, and let the agent call hv_connections.
Use HYPERVIBE_GITHUB_PACKAGES_TOKEN for private package pulls. Build jobs may receive it as NODE_AUTH_TOKEN. GitHub issues GITHUB_TOKEN separately to each workflow job.

To add or replace only package-read access on an existing verified connection, use that exact scope with credentialsRef="dotenv:/absolute/path/.env#HYPERVIBE_GITHUB_PACKAGES_TOKEN" and credentialsKey="packageReadToken". Hypervibe privately preserves its existing API credential and verifies both tokens belong to the same account before saving the package role.
Existing names remain usable through an explicit credentialsRef or credentialsMap. A missing source must be supplied for the requested role.
An explicitly referenced variable wins. If it is absent and multiple aliases contain different values, Hypervibe blocks instead of guessing.
A read:packages-only token cannot manage repository infrastructure; use it only as packageReadToken.
Fine-grained PAT responses do not expose classic OAuth scopes. Hypervibe verifies identity and discovers missing endpoint permissions during plan/apply.

A classic apiToken remains supported for compatibility and needs repo + workflow (https://github.com/settings/tokens/new?scopes=repo%2Cworkflow&description=Hypervibe+GitHub+API+for+companion-refresh); security endpoints may also need security_events.
